note: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs, fried or baked, halved

dish.make_ahead: Fry or bake fresh

steps.text: Boil six of the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Wrap each egg in sausage meat, then roll in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Deep fry at 170C for 6 minutes, or bake at 200C for 25 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Halve to serve.

note: Bananas stuffed with chocolate and marshmallows, foil-wrapped and cooked on the barbecue

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Slit the bananas lengthways through the top skin without cutting through the bottom and open slightly.
Stuff with chocolate and marshmallows. Wrap each in foil.
Cook on a barbecue or at 200C in the oven until melted.
Open the foil, scatter with crushed biscuits and eat with spoons.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: Dead Man's Chest (2006)
note: Pork and pineapple skewers glazed with chili lime honey, grilled over coals

dish.make_ahead: Skewer up to 4 hours ahead, grill fresh

ingredients.item: pork scotch fillet, cut into chunks

steps.text: Thread the pork and pineapple onto skewers.
Warm the honey with the chilli and lime juice.
Grill over hot coals, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred on all sides.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007)
note: Steamed pork and shrimp dumplings with soy, black vinegar and chili oil

dish.make_ahead: Fill and pleat up to 1 day ahead, steam fresh

ingredients.item: soy sauce, plus extra for dipping

steps.text: Mix the pork, prawns, soy and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam in a lined bamboo basket.

note: Grilled lemon oregano chicken pieces on toothpicks, lemon mayo to dip

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, grill fresh

ingredients.item: lemons, one for the marinade and one for the sauce

steps.text: Marinate the chicken in lemon juice, garlic, oregano and oil for an hour.
Grill until charred and cooked through.
Mix the mayonnaise with lemon zest and juice. Spear the chicken on toothpicks and serve with the sauce.

note: Smoked salmon creme fraiche blinis and rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of smoked salmon and chives.
Cut the rockmelon into neat wedges, remove the skin and wrap each with a thin slice of prosciutto.
Lay both out on trays in rows.

note: Coconut and panko crusted shrimp fried golden, with sweet chili sauce

dish.make_ahead: Crumb up to 2 hours ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Dip each in beaten egg, then press into the mixed coconut and panko.
Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden and crisp, in batches.

note: Beef and pork dumplings boiled and tossed in butter and dill, with sour cream

dish.make_ahead: Fill up to 1 day ahead, boil fresh

steps.text: Mix the beef and pork minces with salt and pepper.
Fill the wrappers and pinch into little round parcels.
Boil until they float, then a minute more.
Toss in melted butter and dill and serve with plenty of sour cream.

note: Butterflied shrimp with garlic, chili and lemon, grilled hot, with lemon mayo

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

ingredients.item: lemons, one zested and one juiced

steps.text: Butterfly the prawns and toss with the garlic, chilli, lemon zest and oil.
Grill over high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Pile onto a platter and serve with mayonnaise mixed with lemon juice.

note: Vanilla butter cake shaped like a bunny, with white icing and coconut

dish.make_ahead: Bake a day ahead, decorate on the day

steps.text: Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs and fold in the flour.
Bake in two round tins at 175C. Cool.
Cut one round into ears and a bow tie and assemble into a bunny.
Mix the icing sugar with a little water, cover the bunny and press on coconut. Add marshmallows.

note: Crisp roast wings glazed with honey, garlic and thyme butter

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt and roast at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the honey, garlic and thyme.
Toss the hot wings through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter.

note: Soft-boiled eggs wrapped in sage sausage meat and breadcrumbs, fried, with English mustard

dish.make_ahead: Wrap up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 6 minutes, cool and peel.
Mix the sausage mince with the sage and wrap around each egg.
Roll in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Fry at 170C for 6 minutes, then halve and serve with mustard.

note: Rye crispbreads with creme fraiche, smoked trout or pickled herring, dill and red onion

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Top half with flaked smoked trout and half with pickled herring.
Finish each with a sprig of dill and a few thin slices of red onion. Serve on a board.

note: Grilled half-pork, half-beef smoked sausages in buns with beef chili and mustard

dish.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Finely chop the onions, keeping half aside raw for serving.
Simmer the mince with the onion, chilli powder, tomatoes and water, stirring now and then, until thick.
Split the sausages and grill until browned and hot.
Serve in the buns with the chilli, mustard and the raw chopped onion.

note: Mini bagels with dill cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and red onion

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assembled and chilled

steps.text: Split the bagels and toast until golden.
Mix the cream cheese with the lemon zest, dill and salt.
Spread thickly on each bagel half, then top with folds of smoked salmon, thin rings of red onion and a few capers.
Finish with pepper and a little more dill.

note: Peanut and chili spiced beef skewers grilled until charred, with onion and tomato

dish.make_ahead: Spice mix up to 1 week, store airtight

ingredients.item: beef rump, cut into thin strips

steps.text: Mix the ground peanuts with the paprika, ginger, chilli flakes and salt.
Thread the beef onto soaked skewers and coat all over in the spice.
Grill on high heat until charred.
Serve with sliced onion and tomato, sprinkled with more spice.

note: Sliced grilled bratwurst in curry tomato sauce, with crisp baked fries

ingredients.item: curry powder, plus extra for dusting

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss in oil and spread on trays.
Bake at 220C, turning once, until crisp.
Grill the bratwurst until browned, then slice into rounds.
Warm the tomato sauce with the curry powder and paprika.
Pour over the sausage, dust with curry powder and serve with the fries.

note: Double-fried crispy wings in a sticky gochujang, honey and garlic glaze

steps.text: Pat the wings very dry.
Fry at 160C in batches until cooked, then rest on a rack.
Fry again at 190C until crackly and golden.
Warm the gochujang with the honey, garlic and soy until glossy.
Toss the wings through the glaze and scatter with sesame seeds.

note: Peanut spiced thin beef skewers grilled hot, with red onion and tomato

steps.text: Grind the peanuts with the paprika, ginger, chilli flakes and salt.
Coat the beef in the spice and thread onto skewers.
Grill hot until charred.
Serve with sliced red onion and tomato.

note: Baked dough scrolls with tomato paste, ham, cheddar and oregano

dish.n: School bus ham and cheese pizza scrolls
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Rub the butter into the flour, then mix in the milk to a soft dough.
Roll out to a 30 x 40cm rectangle and spread with tomato paste.
Scatter with ham, cheddar and oregano, then roll up from the long side.
Cut into 12 slices and lay cut side up in a lined tin.
Bake at 210C until golden.

note: Six colors of jelly layered in cups, red, orange, green, yellow, purple and blue

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Make up the red, orange and green jellies as the packets say.
Steep the pea flowers in the boiling water, strain, then dissolve some gelatine in each of the apple, grape and blue liquids.
Divide the fruit between glasses by colour and pour the matching jelly over each.
Chill until set, at least 4 hours.
Whip the cream with the vanilla and spoon on top to serve.

note: Crumbed saffron risotto balls with mozzarella centers, fried golden

dish.make_ahead: Make the risotto up to 1 day ahead; fry just before serving

steps.text: Cook the rice with the hot stock and saffron into a risotto, stir in the parmesan, then spread out to cool.
Chill overnight or at least a few hours until firm.
Roll into balls around cubes of mozzarella, coat in egg and then panko.
Fry at 180C in batches until golden all over.

note: Pan-fried pork and cabbage dumplings with chili oil and soy sauce

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, uncooked and chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork with the wombok, ginger and salt.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Fry in oil until crisp underneath.
Add a splash of water, cover and steam until cooked through.
Serve with chilli oil and soy sauce.

note: Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with roasted tomato sesame achar

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, uncooked and chilled

steps.text: Mix the chicken with the spring onions, ginger and cumin.
Fill the wrappers and pleat closed.
Steam in batches until cooked through.
Roast the tomatoes, then blitz with the chilli and sesame seeds into an achar to serve alongside.

note: Baguette toasts with smoked cod cream, prosciutto and fig, or artichoke and parsley

dish.n: Venice cicchetti, three toppings on toast
dish.make_ahead: Cod spread up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Toast the baguette slices with a little olive oil.
Poach the cod until flaking, then whip with olive oil and garlic until creamy.
Spread a third of the toasts with the cod.
Top a third with prosciutto and fig, and the rest with artichoke and parsley.

note: Crisp fried Filipino spring rolls filled with seasoned pork and carrot

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, uncooked and chilled

steps.text: Mix the pork with the carrot, onion, garlic, egg, soy and pepper.
Roll a thin line of filling in each wrapper, folding in the sides and sealing with water.
Fry at 175C until deep golden.
Serve with sweet chilli sauce and vinegar mixed with a little garlic.

note: Lime-cured shrimp with red onion and cilantro on crisp tostadas with avocado

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, but add the prawns to the lime juice fresh

steps.text: Cover the prawns with lime juice.
Leave until opaque, then drain and toss with the onion and coriander.
Spread smashed avocado on the tostadas and pile the prawns on top just before serving.

note: Panko crusted salmon pieces baked golden, with tartar sauce to dip

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day before baking, keep chilled

steps.text: Cut the salmon into bite-sized pieces.
Dust in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko.
Spread on a lined tray, spray with a little oil and bake at 220C until golden.
Serve with tartare sauce. Keep them away from the cat.

note: Puff pastry cups filled with ham, cheddar and egg custard

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat to serve

steps.text: Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a greased mini muffin tray.
Whisk the eggs and cream, then stir through the ham and cheddar.
Fill the cases.
Bake at 190C until puffed and set.

note: Raspberry, lime, blue and orange jelly layers topped with whipped cream

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

ingredients.item: packets jelly crystals (raspberry, lime, blue, orange)

steps.text: Make up the raspberry jelly with half the usual water and pour a thin layer into clear glasses.
Chill until set.
Repeat with the lime, then blue, then orange jelly, letting each set before the next goes on.
Chill the finished glasses until firm.
Top with whipped cream just before serving.

note: Rye crispbreads with creme fraiche, smoked salmon, cucumber and dill

steps.text: Spread the crispbreads with creme fraiche.
Top with folds of smoked salmon, cucumber and a sprig of dill.
Squeeze over a little lemon just before serving.

film: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)
note: Slow-simmered jasmine rice porridge with ginger, shredded chicken and fried shallots

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats with extra stock

steps.text: Rinse the rice and put in a big pot with the stock and ginger.
Bring to the boil, then simmer gently, stirring often, until thick and creamy.
Poach the chicken breasts in the congee, then shred.
Ladle into bowls and top with chicken, spring onion, soy, sesame oil and fried shallots.

film: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)
note: Hoisin honey roast pork in steamed buns with cucumber, scallion and peanuts

dish.make_ahead: Pork can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Mix the hoisin, honey, soy and garlic and coat the pork.
Marinate in the fridge.
Roast at 200C, basting with the marinade twice, until sticky and charred.
Rest and slice thinly, and steam the bao buns.
Fill with pork, cucumber, spring onion and peanuts.

film: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings (2021)
note: Silky mango and evaporated milk pudding topped with mango slice scales

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Blitz two mangoes with the sugar into a puree.
Soak the gelatine, dissolve in a little warm puree and stir through the rest with the evaporated milk.
Pour into glasses and set in the fridge.
Top with thin mango slices laid like scales.

note: Fried tortilla rolls of shredded chipotle beef and cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Beef up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Put the beef in a pot with the chipotle and water.
Braise gently until it shreds easily, then shred.
Roll small amounts of beef and cheddar in the tortillas, folding in the sides.
Fry seam side down until crisp all over.
Serve with sour cream and tomato salsa.

note: Fried tortilla rolls of beef, refried beans and cheese

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day, fry fresh

steps.text: Brown the mince with the taco seasoning, add the refried beans and cool.
Fill the tortillas with the mix and cheese and roll tightly.
Fry seam down at 180C until golden.
Halve and serve with sour cream and salsa.

note: Roasted tomato soup with toasted sandwiches for dunking

dish.n: Pentagon kitchen tomato soup and toasties
dish.make_ahead: Soup up to 2 days, toasties fresh

steps.text: Toss the tomatoes, onion and garlic in oil.
Roast at 200C until soft and browned.
Blend with the stock, sugar and salt, then reheat and stir in the cream.
Make cheddar toasties with buttered bread, cooking each side in a frying pan.
Cut into fingers and serve with the soup.

note: Melted dark chocolate and cream for dipping strawberries, marshmallows and sponge

steps.text: Melt the chocolate gently with the cream in a fondue pot or small pan.
Keep warm at the table.
Set out strawberries, marshmallows and cake for dipping on forks.

note: Aged cheddar, ham, pickled onions, chutney, apple and crusty bread

steps.text: Lay out the cheddar, ham, pickled onions, chutney and apple on a board.
Add thick slices of crusty bread and a dish of butter.

note: Ham croquettes with a creamy centre, crumbed and fried

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncrumbed, chilled

steps.text: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and whisk in the milk until very thick.
Add the ham and spread out to cool.
Chill overnight or at least a few hours until firm.
Shape into logs and crumb in egg and panko.
Fry until golden.

note: Crispy chicken in a soy and honey glaze, rolled in black sesame

ingredients.item: chicken thigh fillets, cut into pieces

steps.text: Toss the chicken in cornflour.
Fry in batches until crisp.
Warm the soy with the honey until bubbling and toss the chicken through.
Roll in black sesame seeds until coated and dark, and serve on toothpicks.

note: Chilled mango pudding set with gelatine, fresh mango cubes on top

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Dissolve the gelatine in the hot water.
Blend the mango flesh with the sugar until smooth, keeping a few cubes aside.
Stir in the gelatine, then evaporated milk and cream, and pour into glasses.
Chill until set.
Pour a little evaporated milk over each and top with mango cubes.

note: Baked egg muffins with cheddar, spring onion and ham

steps.text: Whisk the eggs with the milk, cheddar, spring onion and ham.
Pour into a greased 12-hole muffin tin.
Bake at 180C until puffed and set.
Serve warm.

note: Puff pastry rolls with pizza sauce, pepperoni and mozzarella

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day uncooked, chilled

steps.text: Spread the pastry with pizza sauce, leaving a 1cm border, and scatter with pepperoni, mozzarella and oregano.
Roll each sheet up tightly.
Chill, then cut into 2cm slices.
Lay cut side up on lined trays, brush with egg and bake at 200C until golden.
Warm the passata and serve for dipping.

dish.n: Gwen's dark hot chocolate with marshmallow

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming but not boiling.
Off the heat, whisk in the chocolate, cocoa, sugar, vanilla and salt until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mugs, top with marshmallows and toast with a blowtorch or under a hot grill.

note: Baked chicken wings tossed in hot sauce and honey butter

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and honey and toss the wings through.
Serve with herbed sour cream and celery sticks to put the fire out.

note: Strawberry jelly set in a ring with strawberries and green grapes

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Make up the jelly with a little less water than the packet says.
Pour a layer into a ring mould with sliced strawberries and grapes.
Chill until set, then fill with the rest.
Chill overnight.
Turn out and serve with whipped cream.

note: Flathead pieces dusted in paprika flour and fried crisp, with lemon

steps.text: Cut the fish into bite-sized pieces and dust in flour mixed with paprika and salt.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Drain on paper and serve with lemon wedges and tartare sauce.

note: Puff pastry wrapped cocktail franks and stuffed baked potato skins

dish.n: Food court sausage rolls and potato skins

steps.text: Wrap the franks in strips of puff pastry.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Bake the potatoes until soft.
Halve the potatoes, scoop out a little and fill with cheddar and bacon.
Grill until bubbling and serve both with sour cream.

note: Cod pieces in a light lager batter, fried crisp

steps.text: Cut the cod into bite-sized pieces.
Whisk some of the flour with the lager to a thin batter.
Dust the fish in flour, dip in batter and fry at 180C until crisp.
Drain and serve with lemon wedges and tartare.

note: Crispy baked wings in hot butter sauce, blue cheese dip

dish.make_ahead: Wings can dry overnight in the fridge

steps.text: Pat the wings dry and leave uncovered in the fridge overnight if you can.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce and toss the wings through.
Mash the blue cheese into the sour cream and serve with celery.

note: Shaved rib eye and onion with melted provolone on slider buns

steps.text: Freeze the steak, then shave thin.
Sear the beef with the onion in oil.
Lay provolone over to melt.
Toast the buns and pile the filling on.

note: Dark chocolate with marshmallows, almonds, biscuit and coconut

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 week, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the chocolate.
Stir through the marshmallows, almonds, biscuits and coconut.
Press into a lined tin, chill until set and cut into chunks.

note: Smoked salmon on rye with creme fraiche, olives warmed with orange peel

dish.n: Iceberg Lounge salmon rye and spiced olives

steps.text: Cut the rye into small squares, spread with creme fraiche and top each with a fold of smoked salmon.
Warm the olives in a pan with strips of orange peel and chilli flakes.
Serve both on a dark board.

note: Mini bagels with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers and dill

steps.text: Split and toast the bagels.
Spread with cream cheese and top with salmon, capers, red onion and dill.

note: Prawns and vermicelli wrapped in rice paper

dish.n: Fortress crystal prawn rice paper rolls
dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours, covered with damp paper towel

steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water, drain and cool.
Halve the prawns lengthways.
Dip each rice paper in warm water until pliable, lay flat, fill with prawns, noodles, cucumber and herbs, fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Mix the sweet chilli sauce with lime juice and fish sauce for dipping.

note: Cooked prawns on crushed ice with a mayo, tomato sauce and lemon dip

steps.text: Pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange the prawns on top.
Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce, lemon and hot sauce.
Serve in a small bowl in the middle. Everybody chill.

note: Crisp baked wings glazed with honey, soy and red chilli

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the butter with honey, soy sauce and chilli until sticky and toss the wings through until glossy.

film: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Mutant Mayhem (2023)
note: Pizza dough scrolls with sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni

steps.text: Roll the dough into a rectangle and spread with pizza sauce.
Scatter with mozzarella and pepperoni and roll up from the long side.
Cut into twelve rolls and sit in a lined tin.
Bake at 200C until golden.

note: Sushi rice triangles filled with flaked grilled salmon

steps.text: Cook the rice and season lightly.
Salt and grill the salmon, then flake.
With wet hands, shape rice into triangles around a little salmon.
Wrap the base in nori, sprinkle with sesame and serve with pickled ginger.

note: Chicken thigh skewers grilled with a sticky soy and mirin glaze

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin and sugar until syrupy.
Thread the chicken onto skewers.
Grill, brushing with the glaze, until sticky and charred.
Scatter with spring onion and serve hot.

note: Buttered white bread filled with ham and cheddar, pan toasted

steps.text: Butter the bread on the outside and fill four sandwiches with cheddar and ham.
Cook in a pan over medium heat, pressing down, until golden and melting.
Cut each into long soldiers and serve hot.

note: Lemon jelly set with blueberries and raspberries

dish.n: Mr Glass lemon and berry jelly
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Warm the water with the lemon juice and sugar.
Soak the gelatine, squeeze and stir in until dissolved.
Divide the berries among round glasses and pour over the jelly.
Chill until clear and set.

note: Green prawns grilled with garlic, chilli, lime and butter

steps.text: Toss the prawns with garlic, chilli, lime zest and melted butter.
Grill for a couple of minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges and pour over any butter left in the pan.

note: Crisp baked wings in a sweet and spicy gochujang glaze

steps.text: Toss the wings with salt.
Bake at 220C until crisp.
Warm the gochujang with the honey, garlic and soy until glossy.
Toss the wings through and scatter with sesame seeds.

note: Marshmallows dipped in white chocolate with piped dark chocolate dots

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Melt the white chocolate.
Dip each marshmallow until fully coated and set on baking paper.
Melt a little dark chocolate and pipe two small dots joined by a line on each for the face.
Leave to set.

note: Toasted baguette slices topped with salami and provolone

steps.text: Slice the baguette thinly and brush with olive oil.
Toast at 200C until crisp.
Top each with salami, a small slice of provolone and a strip of pickled capsicum, in rows on a board.

note: Biscuit base topped with set marshmallow

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Crush the biscuits with the butter and press into a lined tin.
Soak the gelatine, then dissolve in the hot water with the sugar and simmer.
Cool slightly, whip until thick and white and add pink colouring.
Spread over the base, dust with coconut and set overnight.

note: Blinis with creme fraiche and smoked salmon, rockmelon wrapped in prosciutto

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 hours, keep chilled

steps.text: Top the blinis with creme fraiche, a fold of salmon and a sprig of dill.
Cut the rockmelon into wedges, remove the skin and wrap each in prosciutto.
Arrange both on silver trays and serve chilled.

note: Green prawns poached in lemon water, chilled in iced water, tails on

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil with the lemon slices.
Poach the prawns until pink.
Plunge into iced water to stop the cooking.
Peel the prawns, leaving the tails on.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, a squeeze of lemon and the hot sauce.
Serve the prawns on ice with the sauce.

note: the candlelit table set for Lady and Tramp

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 hours ahead, covered in the fridge

ingredients.item: red capsicums, roasted and cut into strips

steps.text: Fold the salami and provolone onto a board.
Add the olives, artichoke hearts and strips of roasted capsicum.
Tear the bread and set it beside the board. Serve by candlelight.

note: Coconut milk set with gelatine, topped with diced mango

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Soak the gelatine sheets in cold water until soft.
Warm the coconut milk with the sugar until dissolved.
Squeeze the gelatine and stir it into the warm milk until melted.
Pour into glasses and chill until set (about 4 hours).
Toast the shredded coconut in a dry pan.
Dice the mango and top the puddings with mango and toasted coconut.

note: Pork pies, aged cheddar, pickled onions, green apple and crusty bread

steps.text: Spread a cloth on the floor or table.
Cut the cheddar into wedges and slice the apples.
Tear the bread.
Lay everything out with the pork pies and pickled onions for everyone to help themselves.
